# How to contribute to Personal Portfolio

Contributions are welcome, whether you're fixing a typo, improving documentation, or adding a feature.

## Issues

Before opening an issue, search existing issues and discussions to see whether the problem or idea has already been reported. Include enough context and reproduction steps for bugs.

## Pull requests

For pull requests, explain the motivation and summarize the changes. Keep changes focused, update documentation when appropriate, and test the Hugo site locally before submitting.

Useful checks:

```sh
hugo server
hugo --minify
```
